```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(icu)

# Session record: appended to the END of every render by this document
# hook, so the rendered file always states which package versions produced
# it. Lives here in setup (rather than as a bottom chunk) so active work
# never buries or deletes it. Do not remove.
knitr::knit_hooks$set(document = function(x) {
  c(
    x,
    '## Session info',
    '<details><summary>Packages and versions for this render</summary>',
    '```',
    capture.output(sessioninfo::session_info()),
    '```',
    '</details>'
  )
})
```
